reviews.summary: Correction: the timed source uses a compile-time #ifdef to select either spmvCuda or spmvCpuRange; these are not both executed per iteration. This bound executable contains CUDA SASS and the compiled timed call targets spmvCuda. That helper allocates/copies the rank-local data, launches the full-row kernel and copies results back. The CPU outlined worker is used by the non-timed reference path, not the timed repetition in this CUDA build. The SASS excerpt is extended through the actual output store and exit.

source_evidence.claim: When the CUDA compiler is available the target is compiled as CUDA and SPMV_USE_CUDA is defined.
CUDA row kernel and helper; runtime-count loop has mutually exclusive CUDA/CPU compile-time branch, then full output gather.

compiled_evidence.claim: Timed main loop calls the compiled spmvCuda helper; the helper copies CSR/vector operands, configures/launches the kernel through the emitted stub, copies device results to host, and returns before the loop backedge.
Exact kernel row guard, complete CSR traversal/unrolled chunks and remainder arithmetic, with final result store/exit at lines 674–676.

reviews.notes: Earlier claim of redundant timed CPU+GPU computation was wrong; CPU reference/worker code exists but is not the timed path in this CUDA-compiled binary. No runtime execution or compilation was performed by this review.
